persons.name: Jitāmitramalladeva
persons.evidence: śrīśrī sumati jaya jitāmitramalla devasana dayakā juroṃ

notes: Catalogue assigns Bhaktapur based on King Jitāmitra Malla of Bhaktapur, though no place name is explicitly stated in the colophon. The phrase 'dayakā juroṃ' indicates the king had the manuscript prepared/commissioned.
